import os
import tempfile
import pytest
from doorstop.core import builder, Item, Document, Tree
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.tree import Tree
from doorstop.core import publisher, importer, exporter
from doorstop.core import settings
from doorstop.common import DoorstopError


# Helper to create a temporary directory and build a tree in it
@pytest.fixture
def temp_tree(tmp_path):
    cwd = str(tmp_path)
    # Build an empty tree
    tree = builder.build(cwd=cwd)
    return cwd, tree


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_001
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_001(temp_tree):
    """
    Create Unique ID for New Text Section
    """
    cwd, tree = temp_tree
    # Create a new item with text
    item = Item(text="New Requirement Text")
    # Add to tree
    tree.add(item)
    # The item should have a uid assigned
    assert item.uid is not None, "Item UID should be generated"
    # UID should be unique within the tree
    uids = [i.uid for i in tree]
    assert uids.count(item.uid) == 1, "UID should be unique"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_002
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_002(temp_tree):
    """
    Attempt to Assign Duplicate ID
    """
    cwd, tree = temp_tree
    # Create an item with a specific UID
    existing_id = "123"
    item1 = Item(text="Existing Requirement", uid=existing_id)
    tree.add(item1)
    # Attempt to create another item with the same UID
    with pytest.raises(DoorstopError):
        item2 = Item(text="Another Requirement Text", uid=existing_id)
        tree.add(item2)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_003
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_003(temp_tree):
    """
    Apply Bold Formatting
    """
    cwd, tree = temp_tree
    # Create an item
    item = Item(text="Requirement Text")
    tree.add(item)
    # Apply bold formatting (assuming Item has a format method)
    if hasattr(item, "format"):
        item.format("bold")
        # Check that the text contains markdown bold markers
        assert "**Requirement Text**" in item.text
    else:
        pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Item.format not available")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_004
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_004(temp_tree):
    """
    Apply Italic Formatting
    """
    cwd, tree = temp_tree
    item = Item(text="Requirement Text")
    tree.add(item)
    if hasattr(item, "format"):
        item.format("italic")
        assert "*Requirement Text*" in item.text
    else:
        pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Item.format not available")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_005
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_005(temp_tree):
    """
    Store Valid External Asset
    """
    cwd, tree = temp_tree
    asset_path = os.path.join(cwd, "valid_asset.txt")
    with open(asset_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("Sample asset content")
    # Assuming Document has a method to add assets
    doc = Document(path=cwd)
    if hasattr(doc, "add_asset"):
        doc.add_asset(asset_path, asset_type="text")
        # Asset should be recorded
        assert asset_path in doc.assets, "Asset should be stored"
    else:
        pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Document.add_asset not available")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_006
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_006(temp_tree):
    """
    Store Unsupported Asset Type
    """
    cwd, tree = temp_tree
    asset_path = os.path.join(cwd, "invalid_asset.exe")
    with open(asset_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("Executable content")
    doc = Document(path=cwd)
    if hasattr(doc, "add_asset"):
        with pytest.raises(DoorstopError):
            doc.add_asset(asset_path, asset_type="executable")
    else:
        pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Document.add_asset not available")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_007
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_007(temp_tree):
    """
    Import Requirements from Supported Format
    """
    cwd, tree = temp_tree
    import_file = os.path.join(cwd, "requirements.csv")
    # Create a minimal CSV file
    with open(import_file, "w") as f:
        f.write("id,text\n1,Requirement A\n")
    # Assuming importer has a method to import CSV
    if hasattr(importer, "import_csv"):
        importer.import_csv(import_file, tree)
        # Tree should now contain items
        assert len(tree) > 0, "Tree should have items after import"
    else:
        pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: importer.import_csv not available")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_008
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U01_2__Decision_Tab__TC_008(temp_tree):
    """
    Import Requirements from Unsupported Format
    """
    cwd, tree = temp_tree
    import_file = os.path.join(cwd, "requirements.bmp")
    with open(import_file, "w") as f:
        f.write("binary data")
    if hasattr(importer, "import_file"):
        with pytest.raises(DoorstopError):
            importer.import_file(import_file, tree)
    else:
        pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: importer.import_file not available")
